summary: Citadels is a light bluffing and city-building card game where players secretly choose roles each round that grant unique powers, then use gold to construct buildings toward a points-based win. Much of the fun comes from guessing who picked which role and using assassination/theft powers to disrupt opponents.
praised: clever role-selection mechanism with great bluffing potential
high variable player powers keep it fresh
great gateway game for social/deduction fans
criticised: luck of card draw for building types can be swingy
king-maker potential and sometimes one player gets targeted unfairly
some character powers are stronger than others
can run long with more players/analysis paralysis on role picks

scoring.why: points come mainly from building costs plus a few bonus conditions like color sets or being first to finish
